non_disclosure_contract.general_principle: For resources not owned by the caller, all mutations and reads return 404 with concealed body. 403/401 is only for unauthenticated requests. No error message or status code may reveal that a resource exists in another project.

forbidden_response_contents: any resource detail (id, name, status) belonging to another project
error messages containing 'owned by another project', 'NotOwner', 'OwnershipConflict', or equivalent disclosure
x-auth-token / password / Authorization header values in error responses
foreign canonical or compatibility IDs in problem details

result_derivation_rules: passed: operation completed as expected with isolation and non-disclosure
not_applicable: scenario does not apply to this resource class (list for interface, etc.)
expected_ambiguous: known client-ambiguity case documented without false exactly-once claim
upstream_provider_unsupported: provider 3.4.0 does not implement this operation for this resource
execution_profile_unavailable: this environment lacks required real-provider or LVM capability
blocked: regression found, ownership fix required, or precondition not met
failed: isolation breach, unauthorized mutation, existence disclosure, or duplicate provider side effect
